description: Visual transcription of the 16 base-game investigator sheet scans stored in Gorlith/Arkham-Horror-Helper (res/drawable-mdpi). Text copied as printed (line breaks joined). The printed Sanity/Stamina numbers are blanked out in these scans and were therefore NOT transcribed. The sheets show $9 for Bob Jenkins and 2 Common Items for Jenny Barnes, i.e. the corrected (revised printing) sheets described in the FAQ errata.
method: manual visual transcription by the pipeline author (Claude) on 2026-10-14; not OCR; each record should be re-checked against the image if a value is disputed

records.name: Amanda Sharpe
records.random_possessions_text: 1 Common Item, 1 Unique Item, 1 Spell, 2 Skills
records.ability_text: Any Phase: Whenever Amanda draws one or more cards from the Skill deck, she draws one extra card and then discards one of the cards.

records.name: "Ashcan" Pete
records.ability_text: When Pete draws from the Common Item, Unique Item, or Spell deck, he may draw from either the top or the bottom of that deck, his choice. Pete may look at the bottom card of those decks at any time.

records.name: Bob Jenkins
records.ability_text: Any Phase: Whenever Bob draws one or more cards from the Common Item deck, he draws one extra card and then discards one of the cards.

records.name: Carolyn Fern
records.ability_text: Upkeep: Dr. Fern may restore 1 Sanity to herself or another character in her location. She cannot raise a character's Sanity higher than that character's maximum Sanity.

records.name: Darrell Simmons
records.ability_text: Town Encounter: When drawing location encounters in Arkham, Darrell draws two cards and may choose whichever one of the two he wants. This ability does not work when drawing gate encounters in Other Worlds.

records.name: Dexter Drake
records.random_possessions_text: 1 Common Item, 1 Unique Item, 2 Spells, 1 Skill
records.ability_text: Any Phase: Whenever "The Great" Drake draws one or more cards from the Spell deck, he draws one extra card and then discards one of the cards.

records.name: Gloria Goldberg
records.ability_text: Other World Encounter: When drawing gate encounters in Other Worlds, Gloria draws two cards that match the color of one of the Other World's encounter symbols, then chooses whichever one of the two she wants. This ability does not work when drawing location encounters in Arkham.

records.name: Harvey Walters
records.ability_text: Any Phase: Harvey reduces all Sanity losses he suffers by 1, to a minimum of 0.

records.name: Jenny Barnes
records.random_possessions_text: 2 Common Items, 1 Unique Item, 1 Spell, 1 Skill

records.name: Joe Diamond
records.ability_text: Any Phase: Joe rolls one extra bonus die when he spends a Clue token to add to a roll.

records.name: Kate Winthrop
records.random_possessions_text: 1 Common Item, 1 Unique Item, 2 Spells, 1 Skill
records.ability_text: Any Phase: Gates and monsters cannot appear in Kate's location due to her flux stabilizer. Monsters and gates do not disappear if she enters their location, however, and monsters can move into her location as usual. * Do not place a Clue token on the Science Building to start the game.

records.name: Mandy Thompson
records.ability_text: Any Phase: Once per turn, Mandy can activate this ability after any investigator (including herself) makes a skill check. That investigator then re-rolls all of the dice rolled for that check that did not result in successes.

records.name: Michael McGlen
records.ability_text: Any Phase: Michael reduces all Stamina losses he suffers by 1, to a minimum of 0.

records.name: Monterey Jack
records.fixed_possessions_text: $7, 1 Clue Token, 2 Common Items (Bull Whip, .38 Revolver)
records.ability_text: Any Phase: Whenever Monterey draws one or more cards from the Unique Item deck, he draws one extra card and then discards one of the cards.

records.name: Sister Mary
records.fixed_possessions_text: $0, Blessing, 1 Common Item (Cross), 1 Unique Item (Holy Water)
records.ability_text: Any Phase: Sister Mary is never Lost in Time and Space. Instead, if her Sanity is 0, she returns to Arkham Asylum. If her Stamina is 0, she returns to St. Mary's Hospital. If neither her Sanity nor her Stamina are 0, she returns to South Church.

records.name: Vincent Lee
records.ability_text: Upkeep: Dr. Lee may restore 1 Stamina to himself or another character in his location. He cannot raise a character's Stamina higher than that character's maximum Stamina.
